dct_description_sm: Türkiye administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 81 Province (İl) - Admin 2: 973 District (İlçe) Dates associated with this dataset: - 16 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 January 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 30 March 2014: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 30 March 2014: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: General Command of Mapping (obtained by Regional IM Working Group - Europe)
